metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Needles, California reach 115 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Needles, California (approximately 34.848°N, 114.614°W) - Date: June 15-21, 2017 - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1 or MYD11A1) or ERA5-Land for air temperature - Need to use a temperature product that can capture daily maximum temperatures 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS LST, use QC bands to mask poor quality pixels - No cloud masking needed for temperature products - The question is about whether temperatures REACHED 115°F, so we need maximum temperature 3. Logic: - 115°F = 46.11°C - Need to check if maximum temperature during the period >= 46.11°C - Valid Zero: Temperature readings are positive values in realistic range - C3: If result is None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., >100°C or <-100°C) - A: If max temp >= 46.11°C - B: If max temp < 46.11°C and valid data exists ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location and time period const needles = ee.Geometry.Point([-114.614, 34.848]); const startDate = '2017-06-15'; const endDate = '2017-06-22'; // 2. Load MODIS Land Surface Temperature data (Terra and Aqua for day/night coverage) const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(needles) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); const modisSize = modis.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS images found: ${modisSize}`); if (modisSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data available for the period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Process temperature data // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius (MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02) const tempCollection = modis.map(function(img) { const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); // Mask poor quality pixels (QC bits 0-1 should be 00 for good quality) const goodQuality = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); return lst.updateMask(goodQuality); }); // 4. Get maximum temperature across all images const maxTemp = tempCollection.max(); // 5. Extract temperature value at Needles const result = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: needles, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTempC = result.LST_Day_1km; // 6. Check pixel count to ensure valid data const pixelCount = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: needles, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const validPixels = pixelCount.LST_Day_1km || 0; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validPixels}`); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after quality masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (maxTempC === null || maxTempC === undefined || isNaN(maxTempC)) { console.log('Temperature calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check for unrealistic temperature values if (maxTempC > 100 || maxTempC < -100) { console.log(`Unrealistic temperature: ${maxTempC.toFixed(2)}C`); console.log('C3'); return; } const maxTempF = (maxTempC * 9/5) + 32; const threshold = 115.0; console.log(`Maximum temperature: ${maxTempC.toFixed(2)}C (${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}F)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold}F`); if (maxTempF >= threshold) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
